item.tib: brda sprod nyi shu bdun pa zhes bya ba'i gzhung
item.coloph: ces pa brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos nyi shu bdun pa zhes bya ba/ snyigs ma'i 'dren pa gshen ston rin po che mi 'gyur gtsug phud dbang rgyal gyis/ 'di bzhin dgos tshul gyi bka' rang lo nyer lnga ba me yos lor spyi bor phebs pa dang / slar yang bka' gsung yang yang babs pas bka' bzhin dang du len pa yid la brnags kyang / rnam g.yeng khol por 'phyan pa zin med gyi dbang gis re zhig lhod shor du 'gyangs yang / rang lo nyer dgu pa lcags lug lor rang nyid kyang gshen gyi bstan la sri zhu bgyid blos kun nas bslangs te/ gang de'i zhabs rdul spyi bor len pa thos chung tshul khrims phun tshogs zhes pa bdag gis bsdebs shing brtsams pa rdzogs so//
